_howto: Elections polled by the Texas Civix IVIS ENR adapter (server/src/adapters/txivis.js). electionId comes from {base}/electionConstants (base64 JSON: electionInfo.{year}.GE). timeZone is the zone of Home.LastUpdatedTime. countyAliases maps a source county spelling to the atlas name when matchCounty misses it. Set enabled:false to stop polling. Every race of every section (Federal, StateWide, StateWideQ, Districted) is stored with its county breakdown from countyInfo. allContests defaults to false: the SOS feed has no county or municipal offices. contestRules: name rules for this source, tried before config/contest-rules.json.

contestRules._why: "CHIEF JUSTICE, 4TH COURT OF APPEALS DISTRICT" would otherwise hit the shared chief-justice -> supreme_court rule

contestRules.match: \bdistrict judge\b|judicial district|county court at law|multicounty court|criminal district court
